verdict.rationale: Dagster ships an official CLI (`dg`/`create-dagster`) documented with scaffolding, component definitions, dev server, and configuration reference, and Dagster explicitly positions this CLI-driven workflow as AI-native by pairing it with an AI skill and MCP server for coding agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents actually invoke the CLI successfully in practice, and a single unified CLI reference page rather than scattered docs.
